# Badge

*Data display · Status pills, severity tags, resource budget indicators.*

**Page status:** stable · Tracks WEB-27 (#113), WEB-38 (#492)

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 0.1.0 · **Source:** `components/ui/Badge.tsx:49`

Standardized Badge / pill component.

Resolves WEB-27 (#113): component library not standardized.
Use for status labels, resource budget indicators, and severity tags.

## Import

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/Badge';
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `BadgeVariant` | `"default"` | No | Semantic colour pairing. Every variant is contrast-audited (see below). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Yes | Short label text — keep it to one or two words so the pill stays compact. |
| `className` | `string` | — | No | Extra Tailwind classes merged after the variant classes. |

## Usage

```tsx
<Badge variant="success">Passed</Badge>
<Badge variant="danger">Over Budget</Badge>
```

## Accessibility

- Colour is never the only signal: the text label carries the meaning, and
  every variant pairing is audited for ≥ 4.5:1 contrast on its tinted
  background (WEB-38 / #492).
- The label is plain text inside a `<span>`, so it is read as part of the
  surrounding sentence — do not use it as the sole status announcement for
  dynamic updates; pair with `LiveStatus` / `LiveAlert`.

## Types

### `BadgeVariant`

Allowed values:

- `default`
- `success`
- `warning`
- `danger`
- `info`


## Migration notes

- [Ad-hoc status pills replaced by Badge](./migrations.md#ad-hoc-status-pills-replaced-by-badge) — shipped in v0.0.1.
  - `Badge` has no `size` prop — density is inherited from the surrounding text.
  - Colour is never the only signal: keep a text label inside the pill (WEB-38 / #492).
